beats.care: Festival season means more offerings in the river. The CM asked people not to drop plastic or offerings.
beats.what: The drive covered 70 ghats and riverbank spots. Students, RWAs and NGOs joined CM Rekha Gupta and minister Parvesh Verma.
beats.why: Waste and drain water pollute the river. The government says sewage plants for drains are being built.

cards.body: While cleaning, the CM found deities' clothes, broken idols and puja material, and asked people to stop leaving them in the river.
cards.title: What they found

opts: Leaving offerings and plastic in the river
cards.q: What did the CM ask people to stop doing?
cards.why: She asked people not to leave offerings or plastic in the Yamuna.

cards.q: Would you join a river clean-up?

cards.body: Over ₹3,000 crore has been set aside for cleaning the Yamuna, a Union minister said earlier this month.

hook: What did volunteers *find in the Yamuna* on Sunday?

learn.t: You can sign up as a river volunteer on the government's 'Main Bhi Yamuna Prahari' app.
